description: A reusable question, individual vote, peer discussion, revote and explanation policy for conceptual questions, with an isomorphic individual check to separate revised reasoning from copying.
title: Peer Instruction

description: A reusable session routine in which paired learners who have studied the material take turns preparing and teaching it to a partner who must respond, correct errors with a scripted move, swap roles and are then checked alone; meta-analyses test peer tutoring and teaching against no tutoring or studying, WWC reviews of the scripted PALS routine find early-reading gains and small, often nonsignificant or null effects elsewhere, and no claim tests the doses, role swaps or hand-over points.
title: Peer Teaching
